Methanogen.question: HCO − MF + H 4 MPT ⟶ HCO − H 4 MPT + MF {\displaystyle {\ce {HCO-MF + H4MPT -> HCO-H4MPT + MF}}} _____-H4MPT is subsequently reduced to methenyl-H4MPT
Methanogen.fact: This endergonic reductive process (∆G˚'= +16 kJ/mol) is dependent on the availability of H2 and is catalyzed by the enzyme formyl-MF dehydrogenase.
